candidate_rule: Select nested Site pools before route/seed outcomes using one fixed geographic ranking and retain Site identity; separately verify route reachability and activity evidence.
current_od00_pool_limitation: The prior pool selected charging Sites only, set effects C and used meal-or-toilet as schedule_support. It is a preregistration development artifact and cannot admit scheduled performance queries.
schedule_window_rule: After exact direct OD selected-road time T is computed, set [2*T/5,7*T/10] using the accepted binary64 T rationalized with as_integer_ratio, uniformly for every OD.
site_effect_rule: C if charging capability; S if meal_count >= 1 and valid vehicle Stop Site; CS if both at same Stop Site. Toilets alone do not satisfy meal support.
